items.question: Trong câu "Arranging the user stories for a product or release by the sequence of the user workflow across the top (left to right), then detailing and prioritising ordered stories underneath, going down", từ "arrange" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Arranging the user stories for a product or release by the sequence of the user workflow across the top (left to right), then detailing and prioritising ordered stories underneath, going down", what does "arrange" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in a particular order
items.explanation: arrange /əˈreɪndʒ/ (động từ): sắp xếp theo thứ tự. Arrange items by priority = sắp xếp theo mức ưu tiên; nghĩa khác: arrange a meeting (sắp xếp một cuộc họp).
items.explanationEn: arrange /əˈreɪndʒ/ (verb): to put in a particular order. Arrange items by priority puts them in order; another sense is arrange a meeting.

items.question: Trong câu "Arranging the user stories for a product or release by the sequence of the user workflow across the top (left to right), then detailing and prioritising ordered stories underneath, going down", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Arranging the user stories for a product or release by the sequence of the user workflow across the top (left to right), then detailing and prioritising ordered stories underneath, going down", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
options: trình tự, thứ tự nối tiếp
optionsEn: an order in which things follow
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (danh từ): trình tự, thứ tự nối tiếp. In sequence = theo trình tự; the sequence of steps = trình tự các bước.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (noun): an order in which things follow. In sequence means one after another; the sequence of steps is their order.

items.question: Trong câu "Arranging the user stories for a product or release by the sequence of the user workflow across the top (left to right), then detailing and prioritising ordered stories underneath, going down", từ "workflow" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Arranging the user stories for a product or release by the sequence of the user workflow across the top (left to right), then detailing and prioritising ordered stories underneath, going down", what does "workflow" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the series of steps to do work
the amount of work to do
items.explanation: workflow /ˈwɜːk.fləʊ/ (danh từ): luồng công việc. User workflow = chuỗi bước người dùng làm; đừng nhầm với workload (khối lượng việc).
items.explanationEn: workflow /ˈwɜːk.fləʊ/ (noun): the series of steps to do work. A user workflow is the chain of steps a user follows; do not confuse it with workload.

items.question: Trong câu "Arranging the user stories for a product or release by the sequence of the user workflow across the top (left to right), then detailing and prioritising ordered stories underneath, going down", từ "underneath" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Arranging the user stories for a product or release by the sequence of the user workflow across the top (left to right), then detailing and prioritising ordered stories underneath, going down", what does "underneath" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: underneath /ˌʌn.dəˈniːθ/ (trạng từ): ở phía dưới. Underneath = bên dưới; trong story map, story chi tiết được xếp bên dưới từng bước workflow.
items.explanationEn: underneath /ˌʌn.dəˈniːθ/ (adverb): below. Underneath means below; in a story map detailed stories sit below each workflow step.

items.question: Trong câu "A visual technique that analyses user interactions with a product by sketching out each step of the user experience", từ "visual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A visual technique that analyses user interactions with a product by sketching out each step of the user experience", what does "visual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: visual /ˈvɪʒ.u.əl/ (tính từ): trực quan, bằng hình ảnh. Visual technique = kỹ thuật trực quan bằng hình; đừng nhầm với virtual (ảo).
items.explanationEn: visual /ˈvɪʒ.u.əl/ (adjective): using images you can see. A visual technique uses pictures; do not confuse visual with virtual.

items.question: Trong câu "A visual technique that analyses user interactions with a product by sketching out each step of the user experience", từ "interaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A visual technique that analyses user interactions with a product by sketching out each step of the user experience", what does "interaction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interaction /ˌɪn.təˈræk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tương tác. User interactions with a product = cách người dùng tương tác với sản phẩm; động từ interact with.
items.explanationEn: interaction /ˌɪn.təˈræk.ʃən/ (noun): action between user and system. User interactions with a product are the ways users act on it; the verb is interact with.

items.question: Trong câu "A visual technique that analyses user interactions with a product by sketching out each step of the user experience", từ "sketch out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A visual technique that analyses user interactions with a product by sketching out each step of the user experience", what does "sketch out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: sketch out /sketʃ aʊt/ (cụm từ): phác thảo ra. Sketch out a flow/idea = phác thảo luồng/ý tưởng; cũng dùng cho kế hoạch sơ bộ.
items.explanationEn: sketch out /sketʃ aʊt/ (phrase): to draw roughly. Sketch out a flow or idea means draw or describe it roughly; also used for rough plans.

items.question: Trong câu "Breaking work down from the big picture to the detail, in the order goal → feature → story → acceptance criteria", từ "break down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Breaking work down from the big picture to the detail, in the order goal → feature → story → acceptance criteria", what does "break down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (cụm từ): chia nhỏ ra. Break work down into stories = chia công việc thành các story; danh từ breakdown (bảng phân rã).
items.explanationEn: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (phrase): to divide into smaller parts. Break work down into stories divides it; the noun breakdown also means a detailed split.

items.question: Trong câu "Breaking work down from the big picture to the detail, in the order goal → feature → story → acceptance criteria", từ "big picture" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Breaking work down from the big picture to the detail, in the order goal → feature → story → acceptance criteria", what does "big picture" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: big picture /bɪɡ ˈpɪk.tʃər/ (cụm từ): bức tranh tổng thể. See the big picture = nhìn tổng thể; trái nghĩa: the details.
items.explanationEn: big picture /bɪɡ ˈpɪk.tʃər/ (phrase): the overall view. See the big picture means view the whole situation; the opposite is the details.

items.question: Trong câu "On story mapping there is a separate question about correct use: it is best used as a self-facilitated or group activity.", từ "self-facilitated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On story mapping there is a separate question about correct use: it is best used as a self-facilitated or group activity.", what does "self-facilitated" (adjective) mean?
options: do chuyên gia bên ngoài dẫn
tự điều phối (không cần người dẫn)
items.explanation: self-facilitated /ˌself fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): tự điều phối (không cần người dẫn). Facilitate = điều phối, dẫn dắt buổi làm việc; self-facilitated = nhóm tự điều phối.
items.explanationEn: self-facilitated /ˌself fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): run by the group itself. Facilitate means guide a session; self-facilitated means the group guides itself.

items.question: Trong câu "Not something the BA does and then sends to stakeholders for approval before a release.", từ "release" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not something the BA does and then sends to stakeholders for approval before a release.", what does "release" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: release /rɪˈliːs/ (danh từ): bản phát hành. Before a release = trước khi phát hành; cụm: release plan, release date.
items.explanationEn: release /rɪˈliːs/ (noun): a version made available. Before a release means before shipping a version; collocations: release plan, release date.

items.question: Trong câu "Not a roadmapping technique — a story map has a different focus from a product roadmap.", từ "focus" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not a roadmapping technique — a story map has a different focus from a product roadmap.", what does "focus" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: focus /ˈfəʊ.kəs/ (danh từ): trọng tâm. A different focus from X = trọng tâm khác với X; động từ focus on.
items.explanationEn: focus /ˈfəʊ.kəs/ (noun): the main point of attention. A different focus from X means a different main concern; the verb is focus on.

items.question: Trong câu "A user story states who the end user is, what they need, and why.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A user story states who the end user is, what they need, and why.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ, phát biểu. State who/what/why = nêu rõ ai/cái gì/tại sao; danh từ statement (câu phát biểu).
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. State who, what and why means say them clearly; the noun is statement.

items.question: Trong câu "A user story states who the end user is, what they need, and why.", từ "end user" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A user story states who the end user is, what they need, and why.", what does "end user" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the final person using a product
items.explanation: end user /ˌend ˈjuː.zər/ (cụm từ): người dùng cuối. End users = người thật sự sử dụng sản phẩm, khác với người mua hay người phát triển.
items.explanationEn: end user /ˌend ˈjuː.zər/ (phrase): the final person using a product. End users actually use the product, unlike buyers or developers.

items.question: Trong câu "User stories are not about what developers need to do — unless developers genuinely are your end customers.", từ "unless" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "User stories are not about what developers need to do — unless developers genuinely are your end customers.", what does "unless" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: unless /ənˈles/ (liên từ): trừ khi. Unless + mệnh đề khẳng định = trừ khi; unless developers are the end users = trừ khi dev là người dùng cuối.
items.explanationEn: unless /ənˈles/ (conjunction): except if. Unless is followed by a positive clause; unless developers are the end users means except if they are.

items.question: Trong câu "This one fixes the UI instead of the goal.", từ "fix" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This one fixes the UI instead of the goal.", what does "fix" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fix /fɪks/ (động từ): ấn định, cố định. Fixes the UI = ấn định sẵn giao diện; nghĩa phổ biến khác: fix a bug (sửa lỗi).
items.explanationEn: fix /fɪks/ (verb): to decide on in advance. Fixes the UI means decides it in advance; the more common sense is fix a bug.

items.question: Trong câu "an end user, a need, a reason, and no interface.", từ "interface" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an end user, a need, a reason, and no interface.", what does "interface" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the screens a user works with
items.explanation: interface /ˈɪn.tə.feɪs/ (danh từ): giao diện. User interface (UI) = giao diện người dùng; trong lập trình còn là interface của lớp/API.
items.explanationEn: interface /ˈɪn.tə.feɪs/ (noun): the screens a user works with. A user interface (UI) is what users see and use; in programming it also names a type contract.

items.question: Trong câu "The three C's of a user story: Card, Conversation, Confirmation.", từ "confirmation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The three C's of a user story: Card, Conversation, Confirmation.", what does "confirmation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: confirmation /ˌkɒn.fəˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự xác nhận. Confirmation trong 3C = tiêu chí để xác nhận story đã xong; động từ confirm.
items.explanationEn: confirmation /ˌkɒn.fəˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): proof that something is agreed. Confirmation in the three C's is how you prove the story is done; the verb is confirm.

items.question: Trong câu "count carefully, since some options get one word wrong and some get two.", từ "since" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "count carefully, since some options get one word wrong and some get two.", what does "since" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: since /sɪns/ (liên từ): bởi vì. Since có hai nghĩa: bởi vì (since some options...) và kể từ khi (since 2020).
items.explanationEn: since /sɪns/ (conjunction): because. Since means because here; it can also mean from a past time, as in since 2020.

items.question: Trong câu "The best strategy for ensuring high-quality user stories is to follow the INVEST criteria: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable.", từ "ensure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best strategy for ensuring high-quality user stories is to follow the INVEST criteria: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable.", what does "ensure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊər/ (động từ): đảm bảo. Ensure quality/that... = đảm bảo chất lượng/rằng...; đừng nhầm với insure (mua bảo hiểm).
items.explanationEn: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊər/ (verb): to make certain. Ensure quality or ensure that something happens; do not confuse with insure.

items.question: Trong câu "The best strategy for ensuring high-quality user stories is to follow the INVEST criteria: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable.", từ "criteria" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best strategy for ensuring high-quality user stories is to follow the INVEST criteria: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable.", what does "criteria" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criteria /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ə/ (danh từ): các tiêu chí. Criteria là số nhiều của criterion; cụm: acceptance criteria, meet the criteria.
items.explanationEn: criteria /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ə/ (noun): standards used to judge. Criteria is the plural of criterion; phrases: acceptance criteria, meet the criteria.

items.question: Trong câu "The best strategy for ensuring high-quality user stories is to follow the INVEST criteria: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable.", từ "negotiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best strategy for ensuring high-quality user stories is to follow the INVEST criteria: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable.", what does "negotiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: negotiable /nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể thương lượng. Negotiable trong INVEST = chi tiết story còn có thể bàn bạc; động từ negotiate.
items.explanationEn: negotiable /nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (adjective): open to discussion. Negotiable in INVEST means story details can still be discussed; the verb is negotiate.

items.question: Trong câu "The best strategy for ensuring high-quality user stories is to follow the INVEST criteria: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable.", từ "estimable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best strategy for ensuring high-quality user stories is to follow the INVEST criteria: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable.", what does "estimable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: estimable /ˈes.tɪ.mə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể ước lượng. Estimable trong INVEST = đủ rõ để ước lượng công sức; nghĩa cổ khác: đáng kính.
items.explanationEn: estimable /ˈes.tɪ.mə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be estimated. Estimable in INVEST means clear enough to size; its older sense is worthy of respect.

items.question: Trong câu "Three wrong approaches are rejected", từ "approach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three wrong approaches are rejected", what does "approach" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way of dealing with something
a road leading to a place
items.explanation: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (danh từ): cách tiếp cận. Take an approach = áp dụng cách tiếp cận; động từ approach a problem.
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (noun): a way of dealing with something. Take an approach to a problem; the verb is approach a problem.

items.question: Trong câu "Three wrong approaches are rejected", từ "reject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three wrong approaches are rejected", what does "reject" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (động từ): bác bỏ. Reject an approach/request = bác bỏ cách làm/yêu cầu; danh từ rejection.
items.explanationEn: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (verb): to refuse to accept. Reject an approach or request; the noun is rejection.

items.question: Trong câu "Making sure the story is stated exactly as submitted — wrong, because most stories submitted to a team need refinement.", từ "submit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Making sure the story is stated exactly as submitted — wrong, because most stories submitted to a team need refinement.", what does "submit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: submit /səbˈmɪt/ (động từ): gửi, nộp. Submit a story/form = gửi story/biểu mẫu; nghĩa khác: submit to authority (phục tùng).
items.explanationEn: submit /səbˈmɪt/ (verb): to hand in. Submit a story or form means hand it in; another sense is submit to authority.

items.question: Trong câu "Tasking developers with judging story quality — wrong, because they may not be trained or skilled in what a high-quality story is.", từ "task" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tasking developers with judging story quality — wrong, because they may not be trained or skilled in what a high-quality story is.", what does "task" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: task /tɑːsk/ (động từ): giao nhiệm vụ. Task someone with doing something = giao cho ai việc gì; thường gặp ở dạng bị động: be tasked with.
items.explanationEn: task /tɑːsk/ (verb): to assign a duty. Task someone with doing something assigns it; often passive: be tasked with.

items.question: Trong câu "Tasking developers with judging story quality — wrong, because they may not be trained or skilled in what a high-quality story is.", từ "skilled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tasking developers with judging story quality — wrong, because they may not be trained or skilled in what a high-quality story is.", what does "skilled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: skilled /skɪld/ (tính từ): có kỹ năng, thành thạo. Skilled in/at something = thành thạo việc gì; cụm: skilled worker.
items.explanationEn: skilled /skɪld/ (adjective): having ability from practice. Skilled in or at something means good at it through practice; e.g. skilled worker.

items.question: Trong câu "Specifying the technical details and components to be updated — wrong, because that is not an aspect of a good story at all.", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Specifying the technical details and components to be updated — wrong, because that is not an aspect of a good story at all.", what does "specify" (verb) mean?
options: chỉ rõ, quy định cụ thể
items.explanation: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): chỉ rõ, quy định cụ thể. Specify details/requirements = nêu cụ thể; danh từ specification (spec).
items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to state exactly. Specify details or requirements means state them exactly; the noun is specification.

items.question: Trong câu "Specifying the technical details and components to be updated — wrong, because that is not an aspect of a good story at all.", từ "aspect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Specifying the technical details and components to be updated — wrong, because that is not an aspect of a good story at all.", what does "aspect" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: one part or feature of something
items.explanation: aspect /ˈæs.pekt/ (danh từ): khía cạnh. An aspect of something = một khía cạnh của vấn đề; cụm: in every aspect.
items.explanationEn: aspect /ˈæs.pekt/ (noun): one part or feature of something. An aspect of something is one feature of it; e.g. in every aspect.

items.question: Trong câu "The user, their goal and the reason — a representation of a customer need", từ "representation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The user, their goal and the reason — a representation of a customer need", what does "representation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: representation /ˌrep.rɪ.zenˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự thể hiện, biểu diễn. A representation of a need = cách thể hiện một nhu cầu; động từ represent.
items.explanationEn: representation /ˌrep.rɪ.zenˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a way of showing something. A representation of a need is a way of expressing it; the verb is represent.

items.question: Trong câu "The same idea but with a lens on the user's situation, motivation, and the outcome they want", từ "lens" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same idea but with a lens on the user's situation, motivation, and the outcome they want", what does "lens" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way of viewing a matter
items.explanation: lens /lenz/ (danh từ): góc nhìn. With a lens on X / through the lens of X = nhìn dưới góc độ X.
items.explanationEn: lens /lenz/ (noun): a way of viewing a matter. With a lens on X or through the lens of X means viewing from the angle of X.

items.question: Trong câu "The same idea but with a lens on the user's situation, motivation, and the outcome they want", từ "motivation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same idea but with a lens on the user's situation, motivation, and the outcome they want", what does "motivation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: motivation /ˌməʊ.tɪˈveɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): động lực. User motivation = động lực của người dùng; động từ motivate.
items.explanationEn: motivation /ˌməʊ.tɪˈveɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the reason for acting. User motivation is why the user acts; the verb is motivate.

items.question: Trong câu "The same idea but with a lens on the user's situation, motivation, and the outcome they want", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same idea but with a lens on the user's situation, motivation, and the outcome they want", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả mong muốn. The outcome they want = kết quả họ muốn đạt; so sánh: output (sản phẩm đầu ra) vs outcome (kết quả/tác động).
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (noun): a result. The outcome they want is the result they aim for; compare output (what is produced) with outcome (the effect).

items.question: Trong câu "User archetypes creating a shared understanding of WHO the customer is.", từ "archetype" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "User archetypes creating a shared understanding of WHO the customer is.", what does "archetype" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a typical example of a kind
items.explanation: archetype /ˈɑː.kɪ.taɪp/ (danh từ): hình mẫu điển hình. User archetypes = hình mẫu người dùng điển hình; persona là một archetype có tên và câu chuyện.
items.explanationEn: archetype /ˈɑː.kɪ.taɪp/ (noun): a typical example of a kind. User archetypes are typical user types; a persona is an archetype with a name and story.

items.question: Trong câu "User archetypes creating a shared understanding of WHO the customer is.", từ "shared understanding" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "User archetypes creating a shared understanding of WHO the customer is.", what does "shared understanding" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a common view held by all
items.explanation: shared understanding /ʃeəd ˌʌn.dəˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (cụm từ): sự hiểu biết chung. Create/build a shared understanding = tạo nhận thức chung giữa nhóm và các bên liên quan.
items.explanationEn: shared understanding /ʃeəd ˌʌn.dəˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (phrase): a common view held by all. Create or build a shared understanding so the team and stakeholders see the same picture.

items.question: Trong câu "The boundary to remember: personas answer WHO, job stories answer IN WHAT SITUATION AND FOR WHAT MOTIVATION, storyboarding answers HOW THE EXPERIENCE UNFOLDS.", từ "unfold" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The boundary to remember: personas answer WHO, job stories answer IN WHAT SITUATION AND FOR WHAT MOTIVATION, storyboarding answers HOW THE EXPERIENCE UNFOLDS.", what does "unfold" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: unfold /ʌnˈfəʊld/ (động từ): diễn ra, hé lộ dần. How the experience unfolds = trải nghiệm diễn ra như thế nào; cụm: as events unfold.
items.explanationEn: unfold /ʌnˈfəʊld/ (verb): to develop step by step. How the experience unfolds is how it develops over time; e.g. as events unfold.

items.question: Trong câu "Gherkin expresses acceptance criteria as Given / When / Then", từ "express" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gherkin expresses acceptance criteria as Given / When / Then", what does "express" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put into a form or words
items.explanation: express /ɪkˈspres/ (động từ): diễn đạt, thể hiện. Express criteria as Given/When/Then = diễn đạt tiêu chí dưới dạng Given/When/Then.
items.explanationEn: express /ɪkˈspres/ (verb): to put into a form or words. Express criteria as Given/When/Then means write them in that form.

items.question: Trong câu "principle, and it sits in the delivery horizon.", từ "sit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "principle, and it sits in the delivery horizon.", what does "sit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sit /sɪt/ (động từ): nằm ở, thuộc về. Sit in/within X = nằm trong phạm vi X; nghĩa khác: sit an exam (dự thi).
items.explanationEn: sit /sɪt/ (verb): to be located in. Sit in or within X means belong to X; another sense is sit an exam.

items.question: Trong câu "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", từ "spike" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", what does "spike" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a hard hit of a ball
items.explanation: spike /spaɪk/ (danh từ): đợt nghiên cứu ngắn (agile). Trong agile, spike là việc nghiên cứu có giới hạn thời gian; nghĩa khác: a spike in traffic (lưu lượng tăng vọt).
items.explanationEn: spike /spaɪk/ (noun): a short research task. In agile a spike is time-limited research; another sense is a spike in traffic.

items.question: Trong câu "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", từ "time-boxed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", what does "time-boxed" (adjective) mean?
options: giới hạn thời gian cố định
items.explanation: time-boxed /ˈtaɪm bɒkst/ (tính từ): giới hạn thời gian cố định. Time-boxed = được giới hạn trong một khoảng thời gian cố định; danh từ timebox.
items.explanationEn: time-boxed /ˈtaɪm bɒkst/ (adjective): limited to a fixed period. Time-boxed work stops when the fixed period ends; the noun is timebox.

items.question: Trong câu "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", từ "effort" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", what does "effort" (noun) mean?
options: hoạt động, nỗ lực (có tổ chức)
items.explanation: effort /ˈef.ət/ (danh từ): hoạt động, nỗ lực (có tổ chức). A time-boxed effort = một đầu việc có giới hạn thời gian; cụm khác: estimate the effort (ước lượng công sức).
items.explanationEn: effort /ˈef.ət/ (noun): an organised piece of work. A time-boxed effort is an organised piece of work; compare estimate the effort, meaning amount of work.

items.question: Trong câu "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", từ "ambiguity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", what does "ambiguity" (noun) mean?
options: sự mơ hồ, không rõ ràng
items.explanation: ambiguity /ˌæm.bɪˈɡjuː.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sự mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. Remove/reduce ambiguity = loại bỏ sự mơ hồ; tính từ ambiguous.
items.explanationEn: ambiguity /ˌæm.bɪˈɡjuː.ə.ti/ (noun): unclear or double meaning. Remove or reduce ambiguity; the adjective is ambiguous.

items.question: Trong câu "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", từ "estimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A spike is a time-boxed effort used to do the investigation, research or work needed to remove ambiguity and estimate and deliver a backlog item.", what does "estimate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (động từ): ước lượng. Estimate a backlog item = ước lượng độ lớn/công sức; danh từ estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (verb): to roughly calculate. Estimate a backlog item means size it roughly; the noun estimate ends in /mət/.

items.question: Trong câu "Splitting a large user story into smaller ones, and identifying where risk and complexity occur", từ "complexity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Splitting a large user story into smaller ones, and identifying where risk and complexity occur", what does "complexity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.ti/ (danh từ): độ phức tạp. Risk and complexity = rủi ro và độ phức tạp; tính từ complex.
items.explanationEn: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.ti/ (noun): the state of being complicated. Risk and complexity often go together; the adjective is complex.

items.question: Trong câu "Splitting a large user story into smaller ones, and identifying where risk and complexity occur", từ "occur" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Splitting a large user story into smaller ones, and identifying where risk and complexity occur", what does "occur" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: occur /əˈkɜːr/ (động từ): xảy ra, xuất hiện. Where risk occurs = rủi ro xuất hiện ở đâu; nghĩa khác: it occurred to me (tôi chợt nghĩ ra).
items.explanationEn: occur /əˈkɜːr/ (verb): to happen. Where risk occurs means where it happens; another sense is it occurred to me.

items.question: Trong câu "Design — design is not a type of spike either, although what you learn in a spike may heavily influence design decisions.", từ "heavily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design — design is not a type of spike either, although what you learn in a spike may heavily influence design decisions.", what does "heavily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: heavily /ˈhev.ɪ.li/ (trạng từ): rất nhiều, đáng kể. Heavily influence/depend on = ảnh hưởng/phụ thuộc rất nhiều.
items.explanationEn: heavily /ˈhev.ɪ.li/ (adverb): to a great degree. Heavily influence or depend on means to a great degree.

items.question: Trong câu "Design — design is not a type of spike either, although what you learn in a spike may heavily influence design decisions.", từ "influence" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design — design is not a type of spike either, although what you learn in a spike may heavily influence design decisions.", what does "influence" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng đến. Influence decisions = ảnh hưởng đến quyết định; danh từ cùng dạng: have an influence on.
items.explanationEn: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (verb): to have an effect on. Influence decisions means affect them; the noun form: have an influence on.

items.question: Trong câu "MVP — the source is strict about the term itself: it is Minimal Viable Product.", từ "strict" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MVP — the source is strict about the term itself: it is Minimal Viable Product.", what does "strict" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: strict /strɪkt/ (tính từ): nghiêm ngặt, chặt chẽ. Be strict about something = khắt khe về điều gì; trạng từ strictly (strictly speaking).
items.explanationEn: strict /strɪkt/ (adjective): demanding exact rules. Be strict about something means insist on exactness; adverb strictly, as in strictly speaking.

items.question: Trong câu "MVP — the source is strict about the term itself: it is Minimal Viable Product.", từ "viable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MVP — the source is strict about the term itself: it is Minimal Viable Product.", what does "viable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: viable /ˈvaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): khả thi, dùng được. Minimal Viable Product = sản phẩm khả thi tối thiểu; cụm: a viable option (phương án khả thi).
items.explanationEn: viable /ˈvaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to work successfully. Minimal Viable Product is the smallest product that can work; e.g. a viable option.

items.question: Trong câu "An MVP is the minimal functionality needed in the product to start learning and to get feedback that informs further decisions — that is, the capabilities needed to merit releasing a new product.", từ "minimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An MVP is the minimal functionality needed in the product to start learning and to get feedback that informs further decisions — that is, the capabilities needed to merit releasing a new product.", what does "minimal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: minimal /ˈmɪn.ɪ.məl/ (tính từ): tối thiểu. Minimal functionality = chức năng tối thiểu; gần nghĩa: minimum.
items.explanationEn: minimal /ˈmɪn.ɪ.məl/ (adjective): the smallest possible. Minimal functionality is the least needed; similar to minimum.

items.question: Trong câu "An MVP is the minimal functionality needed in the product to start learning and to get feedback that informs further decisions — that is, the capabilities needed to merit releasing a new product.", từ "functionality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An MVP is the minimal functionality needed in the product to start learning and to get feedback that informs further decisions — that is, the capabilities needed to merit releasing a new product.", what does "functionality" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: functionality /ˌfʌŋk.ʃənˈæl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): chức năng (của sản phẩm). Functionality = tập chức năng sản phẩm cung cấp; tính từ functional.
items.explanationEn: functionality /ˌfʌŋk.ʃənˈæl.ə.ti/ (noun): the features a product offers. Functionality is the set of things a product can do; the adjective is functional.

items.question: Trong câu "An MVP is the minimal functionality needed in the product to start learning and to get feedback that informs further decisions — that is, the capabilities needed to merit releasing a new product.", từ "inform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An MVP is the minimal functionality needed in the product to start learning and to get feedback that informs further decisions — that is, the capabilities needed to merit releasing a new product.", what does "inform" (verb) mean?
options: định hướng, làm cơ sở cho
items.explanation: inform /ɪnˈfɔːm/ (động từ): định hướng, làm cơ sở cho. Feedback that informs decisions = phản hồi làm cơ sở cho quyết định; nghĩa phổ biến: inform someone of something.
items.explanationEn: inform /ɪnˈfɔːm/ (verb): to guide or shape. Feedback that informs decisions shapes them; the common sense is inform someone of something.

items.question: Trong câu "An MVP is the minimal functionality needed in the product to start learning and to get feedback that informs further decisions — that is, the capabilities needed to merit releasing a new product.", từ "merit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An MVP is the minimal functionality needed in the product to start learning and to get feedback that informs further decisions — that is, the capabilities needed to merit releasing a new product.", what does "merit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merit /ˈmer.ɪt/ (động từ): xứng đáng, đáng để. Merit releasing = đủ giá trị để phát hành; danh từ merit (ưu điểm), cụm on its merits.
items.explanationEn: merit /ˈmer.ɪt/ (verb): to deserve. Merit releasing means deserve to be released; the noun appears in on its merits.

items.question: Trong câu "Every wrong option in that question is a backlog-and-approval workflow (create the backlog → review with stakeholders → get approval), which is precisely the non-agile framing the Agile Extension avoids.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every wrong option in that question is a backlog-and-approval workflow (create the backlog → review with stakeholders → get approval), which is precisely the non-agile framing the Agile Extension avoids.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (trạng từ): chính xác là. Precisely the... = chính là cái...; tính từ precise.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (adverb): exactly. Precisely the thing means exactly that thing; the adjective is precise.

items.question: Trong câu "Every wrong option in that question is a backlog-and-approval workflow (create the backlog → review with stakeholders → get approval), which is precisely the non-agile framing the Agile Extension avoids.", từ "framing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every wrong option in that question is a backlog-and-approval workflow (create the backlog → review with stakeholders → get approval), which is precisely the non-agile framing the Agile Extension avoids.", what does "framing" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the way an issue is presented
items.explanation: framing /ˈfreɪ.mɪŋ/ (danh từ): cách đặt vấn đề. Framing = cách diễn đạt, đặt vấn đề; động từ frame a problem.
items.explanationEn: framing /ˈfreɪ.mɪŋ/ (noun): the way an issue is presented. Framing is how an issue is presented; the verb is frame a problem.

items.question: Trong câu "At the strategy horizon, the MVP is used to prioritise the allocation of resources and increase the speed of organisational learning.", từ "allocation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At the strategy horizon, the MVP is used to prioritise the allocation of resources and increase the speed of organisational learning.", what does "allocation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: allocation /ˌæl.əˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân bổ. Allocation of resources = phân bổ nguồn lực; động từ allocate.
items.explanationEn: allocation /ˌæl.əˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): distributing for a purpose. Allocation of resources shares them out; the verb is allocate.

items.question: Trong câu "At the strategy horizon, the MVP is used to prioritise the allocation of resources and increase the speed of organisational learning.", từ "resource" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At the strategy horizon, the MVP is used to prioritise the allocation of resources and increase the speed of organisational learning.", what does "resource" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (danh từ): nguồn lực (người, tiền, thời gian). Resources ở đây là nguồn lực tổ chức; trong IT còn là tài nguyên hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (noun): people, money or time available. Resources here are an organisation's people, money and time; in IT the word also means system capacity.

items.question: Trong câu "Story mapping = workflow across, priority down, used as a group activity — not sent for approval, not a roadmap.", từ "across" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Story mapping = workflow across, priority down, used as a group activity — not sent for approval, not a roadmap.", what does "across" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: across /əˈkrɒs/ (trạng từ): theo chiều ngang. Workflow across, priority down = workflow xếp ngang, ưu tiên xếp dọc.
items.explanationEn: across /əˈkrɒs/ (adverb): horizontally. Workflow across, priority down means workflow runs horizontally and priority vertically.

items.question: Trong câu "Story mapping = workflow across, priority down, used as a group activity — not sent for approval, not a roadmap.", từ "priority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Story mapping = workflow across, priority down, used as a group activity — not sent for approval, not a roadmap.", what does "priority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: priority /praɪˈɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): mức ưu tiên. Top/high priority = ưu tiên cao nhất/cao; động từ prioritise.
items.explanationEn: priority /praɪˈɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): relative importance. Top or high priority means most important; the verb is prioritise.

items.question: Trong câu "Gherkin: GIVEN = conditions, WHEN = the user's action, THEN = the system response.", từ "condition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gherkin: GIVEN = conditions, WHEN = the user's action, THEN = the system response.", what does "condition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: condition /kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): điều kiện. GIVEN = conditions: các điều kiện có sẵn trước khi hành động xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: condition /kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (noun): something that must be true. GIVEN states the conditions that are true before the action happens.

items.question: Trong câu "Gherkin: GIVEN = conditions, WHEN = the user's action, THEN = the system response.", từ "response" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gherkin: GIVEN = conditions, WHEN = the user's action, THEN = the system response.", what does "response" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: response /rɪˈspɒns/ (danh từ): phản hồi, phản ứng. System response = phản hồi của hệ thống; động từ respond to.
items.explanationEn: response /rɪˈspɒns/ (noun): a reaction or reply. The system response is how the system reacts; the verb is respond to.

items.question: Trong câu "A user story states who / needs what / why, never screen details, and never a developer's or PO's own need.", từ "own" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A user story states who / needs what / why, never screen details, and never a developer's or PO's own need.", what does "own" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: own /əʊn/ (tính từ): của riêng (mình). Own đứng sau tính từ sở hữu: a developer's own need = nhu cầu của riêng dev.
items.explanationEn: own /əʊn/ (adjective): belonging to oneself. Own follows a possessive: a developer's own need is the developer's personal need.
